name: tally-rise
title: Currency counter
description: A currency amount rolls up like an odometer, its wheels locking from left to right.

props.name: label
props.doc: The small line over the figure.

props.name: to
props.doc: Where it lands (as the light goes out).

props.name: prefix
props.doc: Before the figure, e.g. a currency sign.

props.name: glow
props.doc: The colour of the light at its core.

props.name: field
props.doc: The dark the light dies into.

props.name: countSeconds
props.doc: Seconds the figure takes to land.

props.name: lightOutAt
props.doc: Seconds when the light starts to drain.

props.name: lightOutFor
props.doc: Seconds it takes to go out.

props.name: pushSeconds
props.doc: Seconds the whole push takes. The shape of it is measured.

props.name: holdSeconds
props.doc: Seconds the figure holds alone after the push.
